(import scheme (chicken base) (chicken io))

(define (parse-line line)
  (let ((trimmed (string-trim (or line ""))))
    (if (not (string=? trimmed ""))
        (map string->number (string-split trimmed #\space))
        '())))

(let* ((lines (string-split (read-string) #\newline))
       (a (parse-line (car lines)))
       (b (parse-line (cadr lines)))
       (result '())
       (i 0)
       (j 0))
  (define (merge)
    (cond
      ((and (< i (length a)) (< j (length b)))
       (if (<= (list-ref a i) (list-ref b j))
           (begin
             (set! result (append result (list (list-ref a i))))
             (set! i (+ i 1))
             (merge))
           (begin
             (set! result (append result (list (list-ref b j))))
             (set! j (+ j 1))
             (merge))))
      ((< i (length a))
       (set! result (append result (list-tail a i))))
      ((< j (length b))
       (set! result (append result (list-tail b j)))))
  (merge)
  (when (> (length result) 0)
    (for-each display result)
    (newline)))
